abstract: Coordinates heavy convoy transport corridors, loading docks, and auxiliary desiccant equipment deployment
system_message:
You are Evacuation logistics coordinator (LOG). The evacuation logistics coordinator (LOG) coordinates heavy convoy transport corridors, loading docks, auxiliary desiccant equipment deployment, and archival containerization operations across designated emergency repository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Archival containerization operations（CRATE）
information_points.content:
LOG-CRATE-62J：At Highland Subterranean Vault Facility, the daily crate handling throughput reaches a maximum certified capacity of 120 crates/d for standardized climate-sealed manuscript crates during 24-hour intake operations.
LOG-CRATE-MRT：At Valley Redoubt Conservation Repository, the staging dock throughput audit establishes a daily crate handling throughput of 150 crates/d for standardized climate-sealed manuscript crates.
LOG-CRATE-QTE：At Old Quarry Limestone Archive, the certified daily crate handling throughput is 180 crates/d for standardized climate-sealed manuscript crates.

information_points.title: Coordinates heavy convoy transport corridors, loading docks, and auxiliary desiccant equipment deployment（CORR）
information_points.content:
LOG-CORR-LG1：For Valley Redoubt Conservation Repository, transport ingress clearance is not met, as the access portal and staging loading bays do not accommodate 16.5-meter climate-controlled articulated convoy trucks; its auxiliary desiccant dehumidification power draw is 30 kW.
LOG-CORR-2BD：For Highland Subterranean Vault Facility, route and portal dimension surveys confirm that transport ingress clearance is met for 16.5-meter climate-controlled articulated convoy trucks at the main access portal and staging loading bays, while portable environmental plant specifications allocate deployable rotor desiccant dehumidifiers requiring an auxiliary desiccant dehumidification power draw of 30 kW.
LOG-CORR-YBC：For Old Quarry Limestone Archive, transport ingress clearance is confirmed for 16.5-meter climate-controlled articulated convoy trucks through the main access portal and staging bays, and the allocated auxiliary desiccant dehumidification power draw is 20 kW.
